checks: Probe performs no persistent mutation and never opens invented snapshot, retained candidate, SQLite or credential content.
Exclusive flock holds the same existing transaction.lock inode throughout all moves; concurrent acquisition refuses.
Exact six metadata hashes, snapshot and staging directory identities, owned guard and mask record bind the sealed operation.
Snapshot/quarantine tree and four staging directories retain inodes, permissions and link counts through same-filesystem renames.
Owned generator/masks removed only after evidence copy; daemon-reload does not issue service start/stop and foreign masks stay effective.
Terminal phase is the final move; an interrupted earlier move retains phase and every object in exactly one location.
Foreign archive, unknown entries, metadata corruption, symlinks, hardlinks, wrong permissions and guard mismatch refuse.
Fresh successful state contains only its original transaction.lock; no new deployment, restore, activation, SQL or secret read.
limits: Live command and identity checks are source-reviewed but not executed by these local filesystem tests.
No root VM claimed; local fixture owner IDs substitute root and the historical staged owner IDs.
An interrupted archive is retained and refuses automatic replay. Earlier phases remain blocked by the terminal checkpoint; a fixed reviewed continuation would be needed if interrupted.
Read-only V3 staging inspection must finish before root executes archive; root reported that inspection complete.
scope: Real private synthetic filesystem moves and locks; fixed UID/GID/paths substituted; production services replaced by closed fixtures.
